root.label: Qantas 737 runway crossing near miss at Sydney Airport

events.label: Qantas 737 runway crossing near miss at Sydney Airport

slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: The incidents began July 27, when a Qantas Boeing 737 was cleared to cross a runway in front of a QantasLink Dash 8 that was landing, according to the ATSB.

events.label: Jetstar A320 brakes to avoid towed Qatar 777

slots.name: date
slots.sentence: On Aug. 9, a Jetstar Airbus A320 was forced to brake abruptly to avoid a Qatar Airways Boeing 777 being towed across its path.

events.label: Qantas 737 and Virgin Australia 737 runway crossing

slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: The same day, a Qantas Boeing 737 was cleared to cross a runway in front of a Virgin Australia 737 that had just been cleared for takeoff, the report said.

events.label: Qantas A321 brakes for Qantas 737 while taxiing

slots.name: date
slots.sentence: Nine days later, a Qantas Airbus A321 had to brake while taxiing to allow another Qantas 737 to pass in front of it.
